sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of 'Find 7 Differences' are refreshingly simple yet deceptively challenging. The objective is straightforward: find the seven differences between two identical-looking images. However, as you progress through the levels, the differences become increasingly subtle, requiring a keen eye for detail and a sharp mind.

The game's intuitive controls make it easy to navigate, whether you're using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. You can highlight the differences you've found by clicking on them, and the game will display a red circle around the area. sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
If you're new to 'Find 7 Differences', here are a few beginner tips and tricks to get you started:

* Start by examining the entire image carefully, looking for any obvious differences.
* Use the game's highlight feature to mark the differences you've found, and avoid counting the same difference multiple times.
* As you progress through the levels, focus on finding the differences in specific areas of the image, such as the background or foreground.
* Don't be afraid to take your time and examine the image multiple times – it's better to be slow and accurate than fast and inaccurate.
* Finally, practice makes perfect! The more you play 'Find 7 Differences', the more comfortable you'll become with the game's mechanics and the better you'll become at finding the differences.
